results.title: Chinese EV tariffs: US 100% vs. EU up to 45.3%
results.snippet:
Key points

- US: Since September 27, 2024, electric cars from China have faced a 100% tariff.
- EU: Since October 30, 2024, importers have paid 17.8 to 45.3% depending on the maker – BYD 27.0%, SAIC/MG 45.3%.
- China: Beijing charges a flat 15% on imported cars; US goods face an extra 10%.
